description: Explore Barbaro's published house pizzas, ingredients and flours. Calculate dough quantities and ingredient balance, organize bake schedules from supplied stages, and combine shopping quantities from already-sized batches. Continue a formula in Barbaro's Dough page. Results preserve source links, credits and unknown fields. Public tools require no Barbaro account. Calculations do not predict fermentation readiness, provide measured nutrition, infer missing topping amounts or save recipes. The interactive calculator is available in supporting hosts, with structured and text results as a fallback.

defaultPrompt: Find Garlic Marinara and show its published ingredients and source link.

Calculate four 250 g dough balls at 65% hydration and 2.5% salt using custom Bread flour, with no starter, preferment or buffer.
